title: DirectoryJobStatusResponse
description: Response containing directory job status information

exportJobId.description: Unique identifier for the directory job

status.description: Current status of the job: IN_QUEUE, MAPPING, IN_PROGRESS, SEED_COMPLETED, TEMPLATE_EXPORT_IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, or FAILED. Serialized as the enum constant name.

fileUrl.description: Download URL for the exported file, present only once status is COMPLETED. Normally a time-limited signed GCS URL (valid 8 hours); falls back to the raw, unsigned gs:// URI if signing fails.

completed.description: Number of rows with data processed so far

total.description: Total number of rows to process

failed.description: Number of failed rows. Not currently populated by the egress service integration; always 0.
